OFF baseline reproduces the pre-fix ceiling-only numeric signature exactly (4 fires, first fire 25, ceiling_frac 1.0; record schemas differ between the runs, so the identity is numeric, not byte-level). The entry's implementation_note_update explicitly reserved this flip for exactly this rerun. Residuals the flip does NOT close: boundary-path inheritance (entry_permitted() still delegates to the need_crossed() level detector -- untested), MECH-286 stabiliser re-shaping, GAP-5b ecological producer, and the 929a recording re-run (all already recorded as separate items).

learning_extracted: The implement-substrate -> run-directly-per-GOV-REUSE-1 -> adjudicate loop closed in 10 days from defect diagnosis (929/933 cluster, 2026-08-16) to validated fix (2026-08-26) with a 1.3-second decisive readout -- the manifest-as-decisive-readout pattern worked as intended here.

C2's measured rate sits EXACTLY at the refractory-implied maximum (0.5 = 1/refractory_steps; 60 fires vs bound 61): under sustained supra-threshold demand the system fires as fast as the floor permits. The margin against chatter is supplied entirely by the refractory constant -- refractory_steps=1 would give rate 1.0 (the documented degenerate setting). Any future tuning of refractory_steps re-derives this bound.

Provenance note: the run executed the fix as UNCOMMITTED working-tree code (manifest dirty_paths = exactly the four fix files; fix commit 63e70d6 landed ~2.5 min after the manifest, one unrelated commit intervening on main). The committed fix's equivalence to what ran was re-verified during this autopsy by re-running the driver dry-run on today's committed substrate and reproducing the manifest's per-cell numbers exactly (deterministic trigger arithmetic).

The zero-cross-seed-variance pattern (all three seeds numerically identical) is expected -- seeds vary env/agent init, which the trigger DV does not read -- and means seed count is not a power lever for this family; arm design is.

Red-team (7c) coverage caveat, verified closed on the recorded numbers: C1's first-fire bound is ONE-SIDED, so a swallowed entry_pressure_threshold (config default 0.0 would give first fire at step 2) would still have PASSED the pre-registered rule -- only the recorded values prove the threshold threaded (first fire exactly at the analytic crossing step 5, min pressure at fire exactly 0.5 == the threshold). Both were verified against the manifest during this adjudication, so the conclusion stands; a future rerun of this family should add a two-sided first-fire band so the rule itself catches a swallowed threshold.
